purpose: Build complete training-set membership indices without materializing multi-million-structure datasets in memory.

query_support.candidate_fingerprint: indexed coarse composition + site-count SHA256 bucket; never an exact verdict
query_support.streaming_join: authoritative WBM↔training comparison must occur while source structures are materialized; locators alone are not random-access evidence

architecture_authorization.persistence_scope: per frozen source snapshot and protocol identity
architecture_authorization.rationale: bounded on-disk lookup for multi-million-record exposure auditing without materializing the training corpus in memory

source_adapter_properties.salex_shard_persistence: one temporary .aselmdb shard at a time
source_adapter_properties.source_identity_verification: size + MD5 + SHA256 after complete stream consumption
source_adapter_properties.record_count_verification: fail closed after complete stream consumption
source_adapter_properties.partial_index_cleanup: SQLite database plus WAL/SHM sidecars removed on failure
source_adapter_properties.dependency: ASE>=3.26.0 + ase-db-backends>=0.10.0; fairchem runtime not required
